Visit our church

Come to our Sunday service, no strings attached. Just come, take a look and decide afterwards.

Come and see, no commitment

Jesus Christ invited His disciples to “come and see.” That same invitation is for you. You can come just once, sit at the back, stay only a little while or leave whenever you like. You don't have to sign up for anything, give your details or promise anything.

It doesn't matter where you come from, your story or your current beliefs — you are welcome at our meetings.

Every Sunday, thousands of people across Spain gather to worship God, learn from the scriptures and support one another. We invite you to be part of it.

What is sacrament meeting?

It is our main Sunday service, and we call it sacrament meeting. There we sing hymns, pray and listen to messages about Jesus Christ. We also partake of the sacrament: bread and water that help us remember Jesus Christ and what He did for us. Visitors are welcome to simply observe.

What can I expect?

  • A sacrament meeting with hymns, prayers and talks about Jesus Christ (about 1 hour)
  • Sunday School classes where the scriptures are studied in groups
  • An atmosphere of respect, love and acceptance — come as you are
  • Friendly people who will be happy to welcome and help you

How to find us

We have chapels in many cities across Spain. Our missionaries can help you find the one closest to you and go with you if you wish.

Need someone to go with you?

We understand that visiting a new place can be intimidating. Our missionaries or local members can go with you, introduce you to the congregation and answer any questions you have.

Find your chapel

Write to us and we will help you find the nearest chapel and the meeting times.
